errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is malformed, expired, or does not match the request filters and limit.

cursor.description: Present only when another page is available.

q.description: Non-blank search text. Trim surrounding whitespace and reject an empty result with InvalidRequest.

author.description: Organizer DID or handle; resolve handles to DIDs before filtering.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Reuse the same filters and limit; omit for the first page.

main.description: Search calendar titles and descriptions. All supplied filters are combined with AND. Order by relevance descending then URI ascending. Search matching and relevance ranking are implementation details; the cursor is bound to the query and filters.
